interpretation: These 25 package observations include the previously inspected Su-37, Carbon-Z Yak and AW109 v4. They are not 25 new aircraft.
Five packages were outside the current container profile; no definition result exists for those five.
Seven MOD members were outside the observed grammar. Their binary-looking prefixes mean a first line-ending error is not evidence of a text-file line-ending defect.
The zero-padding limit diagnostic is emitted before all remaining bytes are checked for zero; it does not prove valid all-zero padding or corruption.
Geometry, rendering, dynamics, controller behavior and physical calibration remain unqualified.
